title: releng-cutover-personal-scratchpad
content:
Personal cutover scratchpad - noisy / quick notes to self

Context: 2026-03 release (v2.14.0). I'm owner of the cutover window for hosted-api routing changes + Dedicated autoscaler tweaks. This is my working list — not final, will copy to official checklist once cleaned.

Timeline (local PDT)
- 08:00 - pre-cutover sync with SRE, PM, Product Eng (15m)
- 08:30 - pause non-critical jobs (batch jobs, heavy eval pipelines)
- 09:00 - deploy model-routing change (canary 5%)
- 09:10 - smoke tests (latency, 95th, errors)
- 09:20 - ramp to 25% if green
- 09:40 - full traffic shift to new routing
- 10:00 - start Dedicated autoscaler tuning (policy update, small bursts)
- 10:30 - verify metrics and cost delta

Top-of-mind TODOs (quick)
- [ ] Confirm backup snapshots for serving clusters exist (S3 path /releng/snapshots/2026-03-09)
- [ ] Post cutover announcement draft for #prod-updates Slack
- [ ] Add fallback runbook link to incident page
- [ ] Ensure Samira has permissions to rollback routing if needed

Backport / PRs to watch (quick list)
- PR #1982: routing-weight-adjustment (needs backport to release-2.14 -> cherry-pick commit abc123)
- PR #1978: kv-cache-fix (hotfix for cache invalidation) (cherrypick -> test on staging)
- PR #1999: autoscaler-policy-v2 (feature flagged: releng.autoscale_v2)
Notes: prioritize #1978 and #1982; #1999 behind flag so safe but verify flag set false in Dedicated until after ramp.

Commands I will run (copy from memory)
- kubectl -n serving rollout restart deploy/model-router -l release=2.14
- git checkout release-2.14 && git cherry-pick abc123 && git push origin release-2.14
- ./scripts/run-smoke.sh --env=prod --tests=latency,errors

Quick rollback plan (fast)
- If 95p latency > threshold or errors spike > 1% for 3 consecutive 1m windows -> rollback to previous routing config
- rollback steps: apply previous ConfigMap (s3://releng/configs/model-routing/2026-03-08.yaml) then restart router pods and revert canary weights
- post-rollback: open incident in Jira (JIRA-RELENG-4321), notify oncall and product slack, pause release

Smoke tests (what I check)
- generation latency 50p / 95p / 99p
- error rate (5xx + model-internal errors)
- token-per-second throughput vs expected
- sampling of model outputs for hallucinations (spot-check 10 prompts)

Comms drafts (snippets I steal later)
- Slack (prod-updates): "Cutover for v2.14 started at 09:00 PDT. We are running a 5% canary of the new routing. Monitoring closely — will update at each ramp. Contact @Samira for immediate issues."
- Email to partners: short summary + link to status page (keep simple)

Open questions / reminders to self
- Can we keep autoscaler burst capacity enabled during first hour? (ask infra)
- Do we need to disable model quantization fallback? Potential for regressions — check with Applied ML
- Should we gate canary by region? Currently global; maybe safer to do US then EU. Add to plan if time.

Post-cutover sanity checklist (first 2 hours)
- [ ] Confirm no increase in 5xx errors
- [ ] Confirm cost-per-token within expected +-5% (console reports)
- [ ] Confirm rollout metrics dashboard updated (link in linked_artifacts)
- [ ] Remove maintenance flags from docs and send final note to #prod-updates

Notes-to-self style (messy):
- keep phone charged. oncall pager on vibrate only.
- if Samira unreachable, escalate to Jordan. Jordan mobile: ext 2141 (add to two-factor).
- remember to run the synthetic prompt suite (synth-suite/v2) after full shift — long run, start at 09:45 so results by 10:15.

Postmortem triggers (quick):
- rollback + >30m downtime OR >10% customer-facing error rate spike = postmortem required
- keep timeline events minimal but timestamp every manual step (important for PM/audit)

End — will refine and push to shared drive once polished. This file will become the canonical 'notes I used' for the cutover timeline (useful for blameless postmortem).
